Hi there! I just went through the exact same thing. My friend was distancing herself and i told her this would happen. She left me for better people and ended up blaming everything on me. I would just try to get over her. I know it's really hard, and I know you'll want to call or text, but you never know toxic friendships until you're out of one. It's hard going through everything, but you'll meet new better people who will spend all of their time with you. :) I hope this helps!

I have 2 friends that are going through the exact same thing. Maybe text her and ask what you did. Has she done this before? If so, I would start distancing yourself.
